name: Ortur H20 40W
tagline: Top Ortur H20: 40W compressed diode for serious cutting
tldr: Ortur H20 40W is Ortur's strongest H-series diode: multi-diode compression for deeper cuts in wood and faster fills. Premium price; compare to Longer B1 40W and Atomstack A40 before buying.
mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line: engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Autofocus, unique to this module in the H20 range
Cuts 3 mm basswood squares in ~6–10 min, the fastest H20 result in our benchmarks
Only H20 power still in stock on Ortur's US store in October 2026
cons: Smaller working area with this module: 410 × 275 mm per Ortur
Wider ~0.10 × 0.11 mm spot: photo detail is softer than on the lower modules
$1,909 at Ortur, $2,099–2,399 on our tracked listings
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 40W SKU on Ortur H20. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other modules via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles on the H20. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.

moduleSystem.headline: Swappable diode & IR modules
moduleSystem.description: H20 ships as a chassis with swappable 10W, 20W, or 40W diode modules and optional 2W IR heads for metal marking: verify which module is in the box.

editorialDepth.advantages: The 40W diode module is the most cut-focused head on Ortur H20: thicker basswood and faster fills than entry modules on the same chassis.
editorialDepth.limitations: Overkill if you only do fine engraving. Still a diode: clear cast acrylic means CO₂. Plan glasses and exhaust if the chassis is open-frame.

faq.question: What does the 40W module add on the H20?
faq.answer: Autofocus (the other H20 modules are focused by hand), a compressed 40W diode and the fastest cutting of the range. In October 2026 Ortur listed it at $1,909 with a free air pump, and $2,548 with the added 2W IR module; it was the only H20 power still in stock on the US store.

faq.question: How thick can the H20 40W cut?
faq.answer: In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 6–10 min at 4–10 mm/s. Basswood up to about 10 mm and 5 mm acrylic (dark) are realistic in passes. Ortur calls it ideal for thick cutting but publishes no thickness figures.

faq.question: Is the 40W worth it if I mostly engrave?
faq.answer: Not really. It fills fast (~60–150 mm/s in our tests), but its ~0.10 × 0.11 mm spot is wider than the lower modules', and Ortur's 20W bundle was about $530 cheaper. Take the 40W if cutting 6–10 mm stock is a weekly job.

standoutFeatures.title: Autofocus
standoutFeatures.body: Ortur fits autofocus only on the 40W module of the H20, which saves time when switching between materials of different thickness.

standoutFeatures.title: Serious cutting in an enclosure
standoutFeatures.body: 3 mm basswood squares in about 6–10 min in our benchmarks, with around 10 mm reachable in passes.

standoutFeatures.title: Air pump included
standoutFeatures.body: Ortur bundles a free air pump with the 40W module.
